exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "I think I will/plan to/intend to".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ようと思う matches "I think I will/plan to/intend to".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ようと思う.
exercises.explanation: Expresses intention or plan to do something in the near future.
